description: TC-VP1 per-member balanced perturbations of a merged inner core (gpuwm/storm_merge.py, tools/storm_merge). Member K of N takes Latin-hypercube strata of: central pressure uniform on vitals minimum pressure + central_pressure_offset_hpa; RMW log-uniform on rmw_km; centre shift uniform in area within shift_max_km (golden-angle azimuths). Breakage prevented: Milton 2024-10-08 00Z, 20 GEFS members with one identical HAFS-A core had 948.0-950.8 hPa priors (sd 0.7) against a 902 hPa storm, so the LETKF could not reach the recon/vitals core.

default.note: TC rows, cold start and cycles: spans an observed core about 10 hPa deeper to 60 hPa weaker than the vitals and RMW 10-40 km, as recon-era intensity/size uncertainty of a model-filled first guess
